reuse.reason: Subsequent accepted JPEG-only changes do not call TransposeCopy; the exact original byte-source hash still matches TPX33. New UInt32 body invalidates Whole8 cost only. AVX2 word kernel and common dispatch unchanged; Whole16 stays independently passing. Quarter turns, mirrored transpose, Normal stream compositions and other codec/resize/drawing/text paths dispatch elsewhere. EXIFTranspose correctness remains qualified; no file/subprocess timing claim.

correctness: Every 4x4 source row and destination column stays inside validated complete-pixel spans. Scalar tails cover remainder rows/columns exactly once. No arithmetic on channels or alpha, preserving hidden RGB. Existing32x32 cancellation checkpoints, result admission, local limits and ownership remain. Six new byte matrix/tile/tail geometries extend independent-placement tests; existing shared-root survivor/refusal/recovery control and actual package consumer now exercise both depths.
next: Stop both confirmed-passing transpose depths and close matrix/tile/width variants. Resume the largest remaining material gaps only with a distinct substantial algorithm/dataflow lead. Preserve all268requiredpaths; full warm parity remains open.
